Studio Aire.

Lightweight styling, natural beauty.

A luxury organic hair salon site built around soft, sunlit interiors and an airy, editorial rhythm — from treatment menu to booking, every section stays warm, calm, and effortlessly premium.

Concept & Intent

The thinking
behind the brand.

I wanted to design a salon site that felt more like a wellness retreat than a typical booking page — clarity, comfort, and specialized attention, translated into space, light, and a soft botanical palette instead of the usual sharp salon branding.

This project was a chance to practice a full end-to-end service site: treatment menu with real pricing, a stylist team section, a curated portfolio grid, testimonials, and a working reservation flow paired with a location block — all held together by one calm, consistent visual voice.
